
Usage:   deno deploy env
Version: 0.0.9909       

Description:

  Modify environment variables

Options:

  -h, --help                       - Show this help.                                                                            
  --token                <token>   - Auth token to use                                                                          
  --config               <config>  - Path for the config file                                                                   
  --ignore               <path>    - Ignore particular source files                                                             
  -q, --quiet                      - Suppress non-essential output                                                              
  -j, --json                       - Emit JSON on stdout instead of human-readable output                                       
  -y, --non-interactive            - Fail fast instead of prompting; values must be supplied via flags or env vars (alias: -y)  
  --org                  <name>    - The name of the organization                                                               
  --app                  <name>    - The name of the application                                                                

Commands:

  list, ls                                          - List all environment variables in an application                 
  add                 <variable> <value>            - Add an environment variable to the application                   
  update-value        <variable> <value>            - Update the value of an environment variable in the application   
  update-contexts     <variable> [new-contexts...]  - Update the contexts of an environment variable in the application
  delete, remove, rm  <string>                      - Delete an environment variable in the application                
  load                <file>                        - Load environment variables from a .env file into the application
